name: agent-darktriad-check
description: Runs Brett Whitty's KontentKop psycholinguistic scorer over the agent's own replies instead of only over user prompts. A Stop / SubagentStop hook scores the agent's last reply and logs the per-metric scores, Body Count and CriticMarkup annotation; it passes through by default and, when AGENT_DARKTRIAD_CHECK_BLOCK_AT is set, blocks at that Body Count and hands the annotated reply back. A companion skill names nine evasion patterns and says which ones KontentKop's metrics can and cannot catch.
